status: PREDECLARED before any GPU run, 2026-10-08, p6 (protocol); execution pC/p6; authorized by rule 'GPU free account <= 2 h' (Marcel 8/10)
purpose: calibration only: seconds/step and memory per arm on a GPU, and a learning-sanity check of the detector; NO comparison of arms, NO claim
account: Google FREE account (Colab free GPU, or Kaggle T4 if Colab gives no GPU); account name recorded in the report

data.source: Mille Feuilles generated ON the Colab VM from the mille-feuilles source bundle (no image upload from the Mac: local disk ~0.2 GiB free, upload 12-50 KB/s)
data.generation: profile and command of runs/pilot-v0.2 (pages 2680x3698, 4-6 columns), seed 20261008, 60 pages: mf_0000..mf_0049 train, mf_0050..mf_0059 eval
data.source_identity: mille-feuilles cloned on the VM from a git bundle of ~/heritage-synth at commit 23875ab05425ce2aa07742bf314d02436c2f5642 (full tree, incl. docs/CADRAGE.md and tools/cadrage/sortie/fichiers_lus.tsv required by build_dataset, and .git required by git_state)

model_and_protocol: stage_s_* modules and scripts/train_stage_s_v2.py logic as in reports/stage_s_smoke_v2_summary.json (config v2: tiles 768, line_centered_windows, detection on intersected lines, L_geo and CTC on fully included lines, page-level evaluation), device cuda

schedule.sigma_annealing: geometric 1h -> 0.1h over the arm's planned steps
schedule.global_guard: before each arm: cap = min(30, remaining_of_120 - 5) minutes; an arm is skipped (reported) if cap < 10
schedule.cap_scope: the per-arm cap covers training AND evaluations; the driver kills the arm process at cap + 3 min (hard subprocess timeout); the final evaluation runs only if the arm's remaining cap is >= 1.5 x the duration of its last periodic evaluation, otherwise status FINAL_EVAL_SKIPPED_BUDGET (reported, criterion then read on the last completed evaluation)

measurements: page-level detection recall/precision and mean normalized baseline distance before/after refinement at each eval
learning_sanity_criterion: for B3 OR B4 (S2 alone does not count), mean over the 10 eval pages of detection recall >= 0.5 AND mean precision >= 0.5 at the last completed evaluation; a page with n_pred = 0 counts as precision 0 (not excluded); otherwise stage S is NOT launched and the cause is investigated on CPU first; threshold never lowered after observation
guardrail_declared: L_geo trajectory reported per arm; if L_geo of B4 exceeds B3 by > 25 % at the last eval, flag possible CTC-driven drift (DTLR pattern) for the stage-S design; not a stopping rule here
outputs: report JSON + 10-line summary; checkpoints and logs written to Mon Drive/babaorum/stage_s/calibration/ (not to the Mac disk)
forbidden: extending beyond 2 h on the free account
